r42.summary: Addresses that bounce or complain are never emailed again, the faster live channel switches on, owners hear about a booking the moment it starts counting toward their revenue, and a rental covered by a credit card must be paid with that card's network.

staff: A deposit hold on a card now lasts about 30 days on Visa, Mastercard, Amex and Discover cards (about 7 days on other cards), so fewer holds need to be placed again during a rental
If a card cannot take the longer hold, the usual hold is placed by itself, so nobody is stopped
Sales gets a To-do for every request to book that was refused or failed, once per person, car and day; it closes by itself when the request arrives
When a booking that was left out of the owner's revenue starts counting, the owner gets the new booking email once, at that moment
admins: Requests that did not go through on All leads shows how many, the reasons, and each person with the car and dates
Connect the search console with one button and the site reads its own search figures every day: clicks, impressions and average position for the last 28 days
A page that ranks just under the first results, or is shown often and rarely clicked, is written again by itself, a few pages a day; the sitemap is submitted every day
An address whose mailbox does not exist, or that reports one of our emails as unwanted, is blocked automatically and not emailed again
A card of another network than the one that covers a rental is refused on the server before the booking is confirmed, with nothing charged
More people can send requests from one shared internet connection in an hour (30, was 5)
owners: You hear about a booking the moment it starts counting toward your revenue: the new booking email arrives once, at that moment, never twice

The owner guide now says which bookings an owner statement carries: bookings paid by the renter always, and not a booking billed to an insurer that is hidden from you or that does not block the calendar
renters: When your rental is covered by your credit card, the pay page says "Pay with the card that covers this rental" with the card's network, and stops a card of another network before it is charged
A request to book that cannot be sent now says exactly what to change, beside the field, and keeps everything you typed
An add-on that cannot be added online no longer stops your request: staff confirm it in the offer
investors: Fewer lost requests: a request to book that is refused or fails is kept, and Sales follows up with the person
Emails to addresses that bounce or complain stop automatically, which protects our sending reputation
The site reads its own search figures every day and rewrites pages that rank just under the first results

r43.summary: Staff taking calls get a Call helper, only Sales is hired by the AI interview by itself, with video answers scored out of 10 and a stricter pass, every car shows its front exterior first, and the Protection Plan switch uses the car's own price.

staff: When you close a sale with a customer, you keep their conversation on every later booking too
The AI does not answer a customer for 30 minutes after a person replied to them
Check-in and check-out are one screen instead of ten to fourteen steps, with the odometer, fuel and keys filled in for you and a tick on each part when it is done
A late return is never charged by itself: on the return screen or the booking you choose an extension, extra days, the late return fee, a custom amount or a waiver, each with a reason where needed
The caller pop-up has a Call helper with a greeting, a button for each kind of call and quick answers; it minimizes to a small bar when you click outside it
Every list of people and records can be sorted newest first, and opens newest first
Hiring and onboarding are one pipeline with the next action on each line
After each release a What's new pop-up shows what changed
admins: Only Sales applicants are hired by the AI interview by themselves; every other role that passes books an interview date
The AI interview takes video answers only, with two minutes per question, scores each answer out of 10 and is stricter; Redo the AI interview sends a new link
Approvals waiting for you are first on Staff and roles and on Today
Redo photos with Gemini remakes a car's outside photos, and every car's first photo is its front exterior
Switching a booking to the Protection Plan uses the car's plan price
Add a rental: the renter's email is optional for past rentals, insurer-billed rentals, or when marked not to email
owners: Your dashboard and car pages show each car's current kilometres and its next service, in km or by date
renters: If sending "I've returned the car" hits a server hiccup it is tried again by itself
Every car's first photo is its exterior from the front
Returning the car yourself always sends your report: if a photo or reading is missing, staff confirm the return instead of the form refusing
investors: Hiring is stricter: video-only AI interviews scored per answer, and only Sales is hired without a person
Check-in and check-out are faster and late returns are charged by a staff decision, never automatically

r44.summary: Staff make and take calls in the browser from anywhere, Sales sees which cars are free for any dates, every car's listing photos are made to one Gemini standard with the front exterior first, and owner statements count a cancellation only for what it kept.

staff: Calls are made and taken in the browser, in the staff portal, on the business number: your own phone number is never used or shown, wherever you work from

A call to the business number rings the browsers of customer service and Sales who have a staff page open, with Answer and Decline; nobody answering gives the caller a short message and a missed call with its task
During a call: Mute, a keypad and Hang up, with the call's timer
At the top of Calendar, pick the customer's dates: every car says Available or Not available with the reason and the next free date, and Offer these dates starts the offer
The calendar's colours now say on rent, confirmed, offer or hold, maintenance and block
Once hired: training first and claiming shifts online, then a hello in the team chat and your member tag "Name - Position" in each WhatsApp group
Changing the amount of a line on the Money tab now changes the booking's total and balance with it, so no balance appears that nobody owes
A failed card attempt says what became of it: settled by a payment received another way, nothing owing any more, or a button to record the payment
A Sales person who closed a sale keeps that customer's chats, calls and conversations on every later booking
The automatic AI answer waits when a person replied to that customer in the last 30 minutes, also when the reply went to their booking or account, and in the live chat
The Protection Plan can be offered on a car with no value on file, on every screen that offers it

Field staff see Missing check-in and check-out on Today: past rentals they handled or were given, each with Add the photos and readings (odometer, fuel, damage photos), including closed bookings and pickups recorded with the details later
Fleet sees every missing one on the Field jobs page and gives each to a field staff member
owners: Rental history on Cars > Bookings lists every rental on your cars: booking number, car and plate, pickup and return, days, status and your earnings from your approved statements
Choose one car or all, oldest or newest first; the totals at the top count every rental in the list
Renter details, payments and deposits are never shown; a cancelled booking is listed only when a charge was kept
admins: On a phone, the portal menu opens over the page with its button kept at the top, so a long menu scrolls and still closes (Esc closes it too)
Staff who live in Canada get Canadian terms on their agreement (Canada, CAD, paid by Interac e-Transfer or direct deposit) and never read as being in the Philippines
The same phone bar on every Admin page: Admins call and answer in the browser too
The same Which cars are free view on the Admin calendar, with Offer these dates
New settings: calls in the browser, whose browser rings, how long it rings, a forward number when nobody answers (empty by default) and the message callers hear
The AI interview decides by itself again by default: only Sales passes are hired; every other role books an interview
The welcome email gives no start date, shows each step in full, and has a button to the staff portal
A person who works in Sales only reads only their own leads from their own session
Change the total on the Money tab sets a booking's total cleanly; the difference goes on the rental charge
An ended rental can get its rental agreement for the insurer's file: Make the agreements again or Sign on this device prepares it, and details not on file print blank
The replacement rental agreement shows the insurer's authorized days and daily rate, with totals that match the insurer invoice exactly
Insurer invoices carry a cheque section beside the e-Transfer details, never show the CarmaCars name, and stop saying Draft once issued
Take instant booking away is on the renter's page as well as the booking page
Data Health lists bookings whose deposit reads as charged with no deposit money recorded
Missing check-in and check-out on Field jobs lists every past rental without its photos and readings, with Give to field staff
An insurer invoice can be sent or marked sent from the booking; Send by email goes to the adjuster's email on the booking, else the insurer's billing email
renters: Calls from CarmaCars always show the business number
A deposit that was never paid no longer reads as charged on the booking
I've returned the car and photos for Report a problem send from a phone browser opened by a text message link

r45.summary: Every car's listing photos are made again by Gemini from the originals, in the CarmaCars showroom with every plate blurred, every angle present and the front exterior first. Booking requests fill themselves from the renter's profile, a changed booking can be put back to an earlier version, field shifts open by themselves, staff agreements can be redone and a townhall that did not happen counts nobody absent.

admins: Photo standard on Listings: each car's photos at the standard, angles generated, photos flagged and the last run, with Redo this car now and Redo every car (Fleet has the same card)
The whole fleet is brought to the standard by itself every 5 minutes, newest listed cars first, within about a day; a photo already at the standard is never made again unless asked
New settings: the daily Gemini limit is 2000 calls, with 50 kept for new uploads
Generated angles are marked AI generated on the listing; a real photo of that angle replaces it by itself
The plate editor blurs the plate; it no longer draws a plate
Send a new agreement redoes a staff agreement already sent or signed with the current terms; a signed one stays on file as superseded
A To do lists the staff in Canada whose agreement still carries the old terms
This townhall did not happen and Cancel this townhall on the Townhall page
The shift template is a Program setting, and shifts open only forward from the latest one already published
renters: Signed in, a booking request fills itself from your profile: your name, date of birth, licence class and how we reach you, all editable
A licence that has expired or an old address on file is flagged for you to update, and drivers you named before are one tap away
staff: Picking a renter on Send an offer or Add a rental shows their licence, home address and drivers named before, with anything out of date flagged
Restore this version puts a confirmed booking back to an earlier version's dates, car, rental charge and fees, after a preview, without touching a payment
Field shifts are published by themselves, one shift every second day from 10:00 to 17:00, and every handover or return gets a shift to claim
A townhall that did not happen counts nobody absent, and a cancelled one sends no reminders
The guides and the academy cover the new flows of Releases 44 and 45

r46.summary: An Admin can show one lead's full phone number to one salesperson and hide it again; pop-ups and the top row fit a phone; four pages are sturdier; the Canada agreements To do leaves out test accounts.

admins: Show the phone to on a lead (its page or its card) shows its full number to the lead's salesperson, or to a Sales person you choose, with an optional reason kept in the audit log
Hide it again hides it; reassigning the lead hides it by itself, so the new salesperson needs it shown again
A salesperson's ask arrives as a To do with Show the phone
The same buttons are on every Admin lead view, the expired offers on Renters > Leads included
On a phone, What's new, Report a bug and the other buttons of the top row keep their words inside the button, and every pop-up fits the screen
Admin > Field jobs no longer fails to load
The To do to send staff in Canada a new agreement lists real staff only, never a test account
staff: Sales: Ask an Admin to show the number on a lead whose number is hidden; once shown, that lead says Number shown by an Admin and has the full number with a call link and Copy
An alert tells you when an Admin shows you a number, and opens the lead
The number is shown for that lead only, and hidden again if the lead goes to another salesperson
On a phone, What's new, Report a bug and every pop-up fit the screen; long words and links wrap
Game leads no longer fails to load
renters: After the site is updated, a page left open reloads once by itself instead of showing an error
The pay page works with Chrome's translation on
